title: Leaks and doesn't keep temp
text:
Leaks and doesn't keep temp. Pros: ability to neatly compartmentalize cold and hot foods in a convenient carrying case with adjustable straps

Cons: NOT leakproof, only two of the four are temp controlled, and doesn't keep temp for the 5 hours needed for school lunch. The unit is also heavy.
